system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: `skill/SKILL.md` is the main agent-facing orchestration entry.
system_prompt_style.note: Skill bundle with role prompts loaded progressively ("progressive reference loading"); no prompt-render code seen.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `--json`: structured output; non-TTY stdout defaults to JSON
observation_format.note: CLI returns JSON to the agent; artifacts are Markdown text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Agent-facing `boss` commands use these common options where applicable; run `--describe` on a command for its exact JSON schema
tool_call_format.note: Boss is a skill layered on a host coding agent; its own action surface is the `boss` CLI with flags.

tool_count.note: Tool schemas come from the host agent; boss ships CLI commands not tool definitions.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Boss detects the `boss` CLI at runtime. Without it, the workflow can degrade to Markdown artifacts under `.boss/<feature>/`
edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by the host coding agent's own tools; no edit primitive shipped.

tool_schema_source.note: CLI command schemas authored in the boss-cli source.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: it declares only bundled skills and omits MCP servers, app manifests, and asset references unless those companion files exist

loop_primitives.note: Fixed 4-stage pipeline with DAG dispatch, event-sourced runtime, and QA gates feeding retries (`boss runtime retry-agent`, `retry-stage`).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Runtime state is backed by `.boss/<feature>/.meta/workflow-plan.json` and `.boss/<feature>/.meta/execution.json`.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: It turns one coding agent into a structured engineering team: PM, Architect, UI Designer, Tech Lead, Scrum Master, Frontend, Backend, QA, and DevOps.

delegation_mechanism.note: Subagent hooks (subagent-start.js/subagent-stop.js) indicate role agents run as subagents of the host.

human_in_loop.note: Also `--quick` skips confirmation and requirement clarification nodes.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: pipeline state is appended to `.boss/<feature>/.meta/events.jsonl` and projected into read-only execution state.

long_term_memory.note: Memory/knowledge runtime modules persist records; skill library of role skills shipped.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Runtime resume uses `boss runtime resume <feature> --from-run <run-id>` to reload the plan, compare node inputs, and materialize `execution.workflow.nextNodeIds` for the next schedulable nodes.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Gate 0 | After development, before QA | TypeScript, lint, basic compile checks
self_verification.note: Gate 1 requires test evidence; llm-judge plugin ships under packages/boss-cli/assets/plugins/llm-judge; Tech Lead review provides critique.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Gate 1 | After QA, before deployment | Test evidence, no P0/P1 bugs, E2E expectations
retry_policy.note: Gates are non-bypassable and retry-agent/retry-stage commands exist; exact cap not stated.

rollback.evidence_quote: Runtime resume uses `boss runtime resume <feature> --from-run <run-id>` to reload the plan
rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot surface visible; only checkpoint/resume of pipeline state.

termination_condition.note: test/runtime/check-stall.test.ts indicates a stall check; pipeline ends after final stage/gates.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Boss evals score captured fixtures without starting a real LLM
cost_controls.note: No token budget, routing or caching mechanism described; the host agent handles LLM calls.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Hook entries execute `boss hooks run ...`, which dispatches scripts from `scripts/hooks/`.
execution_isolation.note: Runs locally in the user's project directory alongside the host coding agent.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: `boss-skill install` may write to agent configuration directories such as `~/.codex/skills/boss/` and merge Boss-managed entries into `~/.codex/hooks.json`.
filesystem_access.note: Writes outside the project workspace into home directories.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism mentioned anywhere in the README.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Hooks are controlled by environment variables:
permission_model.note: pre-tool-write.js / pre-tool-bash.js hooks gate actions; BOSS_DISABLED_HOOKS lists hook IDs.

tracing.evidence_quote: **Event-sourced runtime**: pipeline state is appended to `.boss/<feature>/.meta/events.jsonl` and projected into read-only execution state.

replayability.evidence_quote: **Replayable artifacts**: PRDs, architecture docs, task lists, QA reports, deploy reports, and summaries live under `.boss/<feature>/`.
replayability.note: `boss runtime replay-events` replays the event stream; environment not reproduced bit-for-bit.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Boss evals score captured fixtures without starting a real LLM
eval_hooks.note: `npm run evals` with fixtures under test/evals.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Use `BOSS_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal` or `BOSS_DISABLED_HOOKS=<ids>` when you need to reduce hook behavior in a sensitive environment.
guardrails.note: pre-tool-write / pre-tool-bash hooks and non-bypassable gates act as action policies; session-start hooks inject/validate input.

target_domain.evidence_quote: **Boss is an auditable agent-team workflow for coding agents.**

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Boss works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Antigravity, and Hermes.
model_agnostic.note: Host-agent agnostic; no LLM client of its own.
